items.title: CVE-2026-61689
items.summary: XWiki Platform is a generic wiki platform. From 4.3-milestone-1 until 16.10.18, 17.10.5, and 18.2.0, the /rest/wikis/{wikiName}/query REST endpoint permits HQL query construction that can combine blind conditions with FROM-clause injection to join BaseObject and StringProperty, bypassing the SELECT-column whitelist. An unauthenticated attacker can recover database values from inaccessible pages, including salted SHA1 password hashes and passwords stored in configuration properties. It should be assumed that, with more complex techniques, this can work even when the attacker cannot read any wik…

items.title: CVE-2026-130587
items.summary: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace tenants to create privileged host-access pods by supplying unrestricted PodSpec templates in Function and Serving resources. Attackers with only Function or Serving create permissions can set privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, or hostPath fields to mount the worker node's root filesystem and escalate to node access.

items.title: CVE-2026-130589
items.summary: Emitter through 3.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows any channel key holder to forge a master key because channel keys use bare XOR Salsa20 encryption without a MAC or signature. Attackers can flip the permissions byte to the master value and present the forged key to the keygen service to mint keys with arbitrary permissions on every channel of the contract.

items.title: CVE-2026-82025
items.summary: WP File Manager before 8.0.7 contains a file upload restriction bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to upload arbitrary PHP files by exploiting a misconfigured elFinder connector in file_folder_manager.php where an empty uploadDeny list causes allowPutMime() to unconditionally return true, bypassing the uploadAllow restriction. Attackers can upload a .php file directly or upload it under an allowed filename and then rename it via the rename connector command, achieving remote code execution as the web server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130596
items.summary: FusionPBX through 5.6.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in app/fax/fax_emails.php that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write files by using a crafted MIME attachment filename. Attackers can email the polled fax mailbox with a spoofed authorized From address and use ../ sequences in the filename to create or overwrite web-server-writable files with .pdf/.tif content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130591
items.summary: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by requesting /api/files/:file_id/preview and /api/file-version/:file_body_id without UserTokenAuth. Attackers can enumerate sequential numeric ids to read raw knowledge-base files and stored file versions belonging to any enterprise tenant.

items.title: CVE-2026-130584
items.summary: Xibo CMS before 4.5.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other DataSets' RSS feeds by pairing their own DataSet id with a foreign RSS id. Attackers with dataset.modify permission can read, edit, or delete feeds and steal PSKs, then use the unauthenticated /rss/{psk} endpoint to exfiltrate victim DataSet rows.

items.title: CVE-2026-130583
items.summary: Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension for Magento 2 before 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Apple Pay merchant validation controller. Attackers can supply file://, gopher://, or dict:// URLs in the validationUrl parameter to read app/etc/env.php credentials and encryption keys or reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-130387
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in coap_remove_observer_by_uri() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read past the supplied URI buffer. Attackers can send a CoAP GET Observe request with a Uri-Path shorter than an existing observer's URL, causing memcmp with strlen to read beyond the non-NUL-terminated buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-119621
items.summary: When importing a T3D or XML file in the Import/Export module, the file hash values of imported files were taken from the import data without validation and used to build the path of a temporary file. A crafted import file could therefore write files with arbitrary content to any location writable by the web server, for example a PHP file in the public web root, which leads to remote code execution. Exploiting this vulnerability requires an administrator backend user account, or a non-admin backend user for whom importing has been enabled via the user TSconfig option options.impexp.enableImport…

items.title: CVE-2026-12239
items.summary: The WP Abstracts plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.6. This is due to a missing capability check on the wpabs_save_regform AJAX action and the use of a static, frontend-exposed nonce that allows any authenticated user to persist attacker-controlled form schemas with arbitrary wpSync mappings that are later used as user meta keys in the wpabstracts_sync_wpfields function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to elevate their privileges to administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-124646
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to insufficient server side object level authorization validation in the API endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by modifying the parameter value in the API request. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to enumerate and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information of patients on the targeted healthcare organization.

items.title: CVE-2026-124645
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HIMS due to the use of a static and predictable value in the client-side password hashing mechanism, which is embedded in the login page and accessible to unauthenticated users. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by accessing the login page, extracting the embedded value and using it to reproduce the password hashing process. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could weaken the security of the authentication mechanism and potentially facilitate authentication related attacks on the targeted healthcare organizatio…

items.title: CVE-2026-124644
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to the exposure of internal hospital operational statistics through data structure embedded in the HTML response of the login page. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by accessing the affected login page and extracting the returned HTML content. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to internal hospital operational information associated with the targeted healthcare organization.

items.title: CVE-2026-119623
items.summary: The installer (first installation wizard) could be re-enabled on an already configured instance by placing a file whose name starts with FIRST_INSTALL in the public web root or the project root. The installer then became accessible without authentication, allowing for example to change the database connection and to create a new administrator and system maintainer account, which leads to remote code execution. As demonstrated in TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-026, such a file could be created by an authenticated, low-privileged backend user without any further permissions. Other ways of creating files in…

items.title: CVE-2026-124643
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in e-Sushrut HMIS due to insufficient authentication and session validation in the dashboard functionality. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted HTTP requests to the affected endpoint. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to the dashboard information associated with the targeted healthcare organization.

items.title: CVE-2026-122122
items.summary: The order-tracking functionality in ICRTouch ByTable and TouchTakeaway does not adequately verify that a requester is authorized to access the specified order. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify an order identifier to retrieve information associated with other customers’ orders.

items.title: CVE-2026-125164
items.summary: The file dump controller (eID=dumpFile) delivers files, file references and processed files identified by their uid, protected by a token. The token only covered the uid value, but not the type of the requested resource. A valid token issued for a file could therefore be reused to request a file reference or a processed file with the same uid. As a result, unauthenticated visitors could download files, for example from non-public storages, for which no token had been issued.

items.title: CVE-2026-125162
items.summary: The cHash argument, which ensures that only URL arguments originally generated by TYPO3 create separate page cache entries, was treated inconsistently when it was passed as an array. The cHash validation treated such a value as missing, while the page cache identifier treated it as present and included all URL arguments. As a result, unauthenticated visitors could create an unlimited number of page cache entries and trigger uncached page renderings by adding an array cHash with arbitrary values to any URL. This could exhaust server resources and fill the page cache storage. Only installations…

items.title: CVE-2026-118497
items.summary: The affected products do not sufficiently validate CODESYS Automation Server TLS certificates when a user starts the certificate enrollment. An unauthenticated remote attacker performing a man-in-the-middle attack can exploit this vulnerability by supplying an untrusted certificate that is accepted as trusted. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to intercept and manipulate communications between the CODESYS Automation Server and the PLC network.

items.title: CVE-2026-118498
items.summary: The CODESYS Automation Server Connector uses server-supplied file names without sufficient path traversal checks. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on a trusted communication channel, can exploit this vulnerability to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary locations on the engineering workstation and subsequently achieve arbitrary code execution with user privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-118496
items.summary: The affected products process a server-supplied URL without sufficient validation. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it or performing a man-in-the-middle attack, can exploit this vulnerability by causing the affected product to process unintended content. Successful exploitation may result in arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user running the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-107904
items.summary: Joomla Extension - valorapps.com - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Easy File Uploader < 2.9.7 - An unauthenticated remote attacker can upload a PHP-executable file to the Joomla web root with a single multipart POST request, requiring no credentials and no CSRF token.

items.title: CVE-2026-129279
items.summary: The password reset function in N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 returns distinguishable responses for valid and invalid accounts. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can enumerate the email addresses of valid user accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-129278
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerII2 remoteControlMSPAStartEndTimeSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can alter the recorded state and times of Take Control remote control tasks and the associated audit log entries.

items.title: CVE-2026-129277
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the MaintActionGet operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read and cancel the pending maintenance actions of any appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-129276
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 AssetDiscoSimplifiedInfoSubmit operation. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can overwrite the asset data recorded for any appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-129275
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 allows the repositoryItemGet operation to be called without authentication. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows a policy identifier can download the Automation Manager policy of any customer, including embedded scripts and parameter values.

items.title: CVE-2026-129274
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 does not authenticate callers of the ServerMMS2 RemoteExecutionTaskSubmit operation or verify task ownership. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit forged results for remote execution tasks belonging to any customer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129272
items.summary: N-able N-central before 2026.4.1 HF3 uses a predictable credential to authenticate appliances to an agent-facing API. A remote, unauthenticated attacker who knows or guesses an appliance identifier can obtain a valid appliance token and session and impersonate that appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-125163
items.summary: The FileUpload and ImageUpload elements of the Form Framework use the property allowedMimeTypes as an allow list of MIME types accepted for upload. An empty allowedMimeTypes list was treated as "no restriction". Forms containing upload elements without any configured MIME type, for example in manually created form definitions or when all MIME types were deselected in the form editor, accepted any file except those blocked by the file deny pattern, which only covers PHP-related file extensions. This allowed unauthenticated users to upload files with browser-executable content, such as HTML or S…

items.title: CVE-2026-111973
items.summary: The RSS Feed Retriever WordPress plugin through 1.6.10 does not validate a user-supplied URL before fetching it server-side with a bundled HTTP library that lacks WordPress's private-network protections, allowing unauthenticated users to make the site retrieve arbitrary internal or external resources and read the response.

items.title: CVE-2026-121684
items.summary: The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-…

items.title: CVE-2026-120387
items.summary: An improper JWT signature verification vulnerability in CIRCUTOR PowerStudio SCADA WAVE desktop version allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication by submitting an unsigned JWT with the algorithm set to “none”. The shared JWT validation component accepts the token without verifying a cryptographic signature, allowing the attacker to impersonate another user and access protected functionality with that user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-118961
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.11 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read commit comments from a private source fork through a public project's merge request discussions due to missing authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-130375
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated SQLite users to bypass the check_sqlite_name() extension guard using PDO_SQLite file: URI database names. Attackers can select the PDO driver with ext=pdo and submit names like file:/webroot/x.php?x=.db to create a .php file, then store PHP source as table data for code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130382
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OtpLoginPlugin that allows attackers knowing the database password to skip TOTP verification by abusing the permanent-login cookie. Attackers can submit a login with a wrong OTP and permanent=1 to obtain a neo_permanent cookie, then replay it to gain full authenticated database access.

items.title: CVE-2026-130380
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-130371
items.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability because the web installer ignores the legacy config/database.php during 3.x upgrades. Unauthenticated attackers can reinstall the site against an attacker-controlled database and create their own administrator account to take over the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-130366
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver that allows remote attackers to log in to passwordless accounts without the configured defaultPasswordHash password. Attackers who know the name of a ClickHouse no_password account can submit any non-empty password, because connect() skips openPasswordless(), and obtain a session with that account's rights.

items.title: CVE-2026-130354
items.summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

items.title: CVE-2026-125275
items.summary: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability in device certificate verification in nerves-hub nerves_hub_web allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service via a TLS client certificate whose CA is not registered. When a client certificate chains to a root in the device endpoint's trust store but no CA in the chain is registered in NervesHub, NervesHub.SSL.decide/2 refuses it with the reason :unknown_ca. Erlang/OTP ssl reads that reason as a missing trust anchor, looks for an alternative root, finds the same root and validates again without end. T…

items.title: CVE-2026-12487
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the SNMP parameter of Zyxel EE5301-00 customized firmware version 5.63(ACLD.2)b3_D0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition on an affected device.

items.title: CVE-2026-79614
items.summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in “libclinkc.so” in Zyxel DX3301-T0/EX3301-T0 firmware versions through 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to elevate privileges and potentially execute arbitrary commands by sending a crafted HTTP request. WAN access is disabled by default on these devices.

items.title: CVE-2026-130379
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the privileged-port restriction by injecting separator characters or connection-string keywords into the login server field. Attackers can make pgsql, Mongo, Oracle and PDO drivers parse a different host and port, reaching internal services and leaking limited information through driver responses and errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-130372
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect authenticated users by injecting an external URL through the HTTP Referer header into the hidden referer field of the edit form. Attackers can lure users from a page with an unsafe-url referrer policy whose URL contains &select=, redirecting them to phishing sites after record edits.

items.title: CVE-2026-130362
items.summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid logins through differing POST /api/webauthn/prepare responses. Attackers can submit wordlists of usernames, reusing one unconsumed CSRF token without rate limiting, to discover administrator logins for password spraying and phishing.

items.title: CVE-2026-130358
items.summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the ClaudeSqlPlugin, GeminiSqlPlugin, and OpenWebUiPlugin sendHeaders() handlers that run on the login page. Unauthenticated attackers can POST claude, gemini, or openwebui fields to relay arbitrary prompts using the operator's API key or bearer token, including to internal Open WebUI endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-130353
items.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its public FAQ REST API that exposes author names and e-mail addresses to unauthenticated callers. Attackers can query the faq and paginated faqs endpoints to bulk-harvest e-mails and de-anonymise users who opted out of GDPR author visibility.

items.title: CVE-2026-130352
items.summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read editor-only Private Notes by querying the public FAQ list API. Attackers can page through GET /api/v4.0/faqs or /api/v3.1/faqs without credentials to retrieve the notes field of every anonymously readable FAQ, exposing internal remarks and ticket details.

items.title: CVE-2026-130348
items.summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that exposes restricted and inactive category metadata to unauthenticated visitors. Attackers can enumerate category IDs via /category/{id}/{slug}.html or query /api/v4.0/categories to read names, descriptions, images and FAQ counts of restricted categories.

items.title: CVE-2026-97639
items.summary: The Everest Backup – WordPress Cloud Backup, Migration, Restore & Cloning Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.14 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to activate any already-installed inactive plugin on the site.

items.title: CVE-2026-16545
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read private project metadata from packages published by other projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-121533
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read restricted job artifact data due to missing authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-104934
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read files from a project's private repository due to missing authorization checks in snippets.

items.title: CVE-2026-110339
items.summary: The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload, causing the daemon to crash and restart. The NSS function SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList() was used to check whether the content was empty, but this check did not trigger if the non-empty content of the PKCS#7 wrapped payload was an empty list. Continued triggering of this vulnerability can lead to a denial of service. Remote code execution is not possible. Authentication is not required to trigger this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2026-130072
items.summary: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130081
items.summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130077
items.summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal hosts via caller-controlled proxy and proxy_list fields in /v1/scrape. Attackers can supply proxy entries pointing to loopback, private-network or link-local hosts, bypassing page URL checks to open HTTP-proxy or SOCKS connections internally.

items.title: CVE-2026-130076
items.summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. Attackers can set llmApiKey and request the summary format, making the server POST to loopback or private addresses and use returned warnings as a reachability oracle.

items.title: CVE-2026-130071
items.summary: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges, take over accounts or tamper with business data.

items.title: CVE-2026-127219
items.summary: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke the admin claim-offer action by reusing the publicly exposed wpchat_frontend nonce without any capability check. Attackers can call SmartSearchManagerService::claimOffer() via POST /wp-json/wpchat/v1/smart-search/claim-offer to register an attacker-controlled email against the site's domain using the site's stored api_token, corrupting the WPChat account and newsletter identity bound to the installation.

items.title: CVE-2026-104840
items.summary: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260428.0, the token GraphQL mutation used for primary login has no endpoint-specific rate limit, while the global Express limiter defaults to permitting 10,000 requests in a one-second window. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make password guesses at network speed against a chosen user account and, if a credential is recovered, access the account's threat-intelligence data and permitted operations. This issue is fixed in version 7.260428.0.

items.title: Sicherheitsvorfall - Kreiskrankenhaus Greiz-Ronneburg
items.summary: Das Kreiskrankenhaus Greiz-Ronneburg in Thüringen meldete am 15. November 2026 einen Angriff einer Ransomware-Gruppe. Landkreissprecher Uwe Müller teilte mit, dass die erpresserische Nachrichte am 15. November 2026 eingegangen sei. Die noch unbekannten Täter verschafften sich Zugriff auf die Computersysteme der Klinik. Nach Angaben des Landratsamts sind verschiedene Systeme betroffen. Aus Sicherheitsgründen schloss das Krankenhaus die Notaufnahme vorübergehend, öffnete dieses schrittweise aber wieder am Abend des 16. Novembers. items.title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
items.summary: At least 178 top web destinations unwittingly served a variety of malware exploits against visitors over the past 24 hours thanks to a security vulnerability involving Optimizely, a company that helps websites customize user experiences and test out new features. items.title: USN-9115-1: Mini-XML vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that Mini-XML used unbounded recursion when deleting and writing XML nodes. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause Mini-XML to crash, resulting in a denial of service. These issues only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. items.summary: Linux Mint Update Manager manages software updates on Linux Mint systems. From 5.4.8 until 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1, mint-refresh-cache passes a user-controlled --parent-window-id value directly to the privileged Synaptic process without validating it as an integer. A local user permitted to execute mint-refresh-cache through sudo can inject additional Synaptic command-line options and achieve arbitrary code execution as root. This issue is fixed in versions 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1.

items.title: CVE-2025-64441

items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-44670, because renderAVAttribute() inserts an Attribute View name unescaped into the database row attribute panel header. items.summary: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Membership grants the BYPASS cap…

items.title: CVE-2026-104920
items.summary: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

items.title: CVE-2026-104007
items.summary: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table…

items.title: CVE-2026-104933
items.summary: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

items.title: CVE-2026-125283
items.summary: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use the try_files and alias directives with a map variable, certain combinations of regular expression captures in map and try_files can cause a segmentation fault in an NGINX worker process. Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to cause an NGINX worker process to terminate unexpectedly. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Impact: This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system. This is a data plane vulnerability only; there is no control plane exposure. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-120967

Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass verification of client certificates. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-132222

When gpfdist attaches a request to a session, it sizes two internal arrays from the client-supplied X-GP-SEGMENT-COUNT header and writes to them at the index given by the X-GP-SEGMENT-ID header, without checking that the index is non-negative and smaller than the count (CWE-129). gpfdist does not authenticate callers unless gpfdists is used with client certificate verification, so an attacker who can…

items.summary: Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.summary: Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.summary: Tanium addressed a time-of-check time-of-use race condition vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.summary: Tanium addressed an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.summary: Tanium addressed an information disclosure vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.summary: Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.

items.title: CVE-2026-132124
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject scripts via the orders_status_name parameter in admin/orders_status.php. Attackers with per-page order status access can store payloads that execute in other administrators' browsers when the unencoded status name is displayed.

items.title: CVE-2026-132123
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject scripts via the cross_sell_group_name parameter in admin/cross_sell_groups.php. Attackers with per-page access to cross-selling groups can store a script payload that executes in other administrators' browsers, including full administrators, when they view the group listing.

items.title: CVE-2026-109861
items.summary: CAST Imaging contains a hardcoded authentication token in the "KeyCloakController" class of auth-service.jar. An attacker who gains access to the source code, application package, logs, or configuration files can reuse this token to call auth-service endpoints without authentication. Using the token with the "/api/auth/keycloak/users" endpoint, the attacker can enumerate users across Keycloak realms and retrieve user attributes containing API token hashes, enabling reconnaissance and further exploitation. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other vers…

items.title: CVE-2026-109860
items.summary: CAST Imaging is vulnerable to Path Traversal vulnerability in "/api/server-folders" and "/api/server-folders/download" endpoints. These file-management endpoints accept user-supplied filesystem paths and allow selected system commands to be executed at the specified location, but they do not enforce sufficient authorization boundaries or restrict access to a predefined set of resources. An authenticated attacker can enumerate server directories via the "ls" command and retrieve arbitrary files outside of the intended application workspace, such as "/etc/passwd", exposing sensitive data. The vu…

items.title: CVE-2026-109858
items.summary: CAST Imaging has multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in various endpoints. The application does not properly validate the path parameters, allowing an authenticated attacker to use "../" sequences to escape the intended directory and read arbitrary files. Critically, by reading "/proc/self/environ", the attacker can obtain environment variables containing sensitive credentials such as Keycloak and PostgreSQL passwords, leading to full server compromise and administrative access. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did no…

items.title: CVE-2026-107516
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an OS command injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to arbitrary command execution with root privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-130721
items.summary: NocoDB from 2026.06.2 before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to write to data-read-only sources by abusing the internal batch endpoint. Attackers can name a writable decoy table on the batch envelope and target a read-only source table in dataUpdate, dataInsert or dataDelete sub-operations to modify or destroy records.

items.title: CVE-2026-130712
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated Creators to access another tenant's external database by reusing a victim source id when adding a source. Because NcConnectionMgrv2 caches connections by bare source id, attackers can reflect the victim's cached database schema and read, update, and insert records through their own base models.

items.title: CVE-2026-130704
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows Creator-role users to attach NocoDB's internal database by supplying is_meta and is_local flags. Attackers can create sources or bases with these flags to expose user, token and integration tables, then read and modify records including user roles.

items.title: CVE-2026-130694
items.summary: NocoDB from 2026.07.0 before 2026.10.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows users with Creator role to inject SQL through unescaped backslashes in the DATETIME_FORMAT formula format argument on MySQL-backed bases. Attackers can place a backslash before a quote to terminate the DATE_FORMAT string literal and read any data reachable by the data source's database user, including tables outside the base.

items.title: CVE-2026-130664
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows attackers to write beyond allocated heap memory by supplying crafted images. Attackers can provide a crafted set of images processed by the magick stream operation to corrupt heap memory and crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-119631
items.summary: The Kirki - Freeform Page Builder, Website Builder & Customizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Unauthorized Data Access in versions up to, and including, 6.4.1 via the `kirki_post_apis` AJAX action's `get-dynamic-content-batch` and `get-collection-batch` endpoints. This is due to the plugin opening these resolvers behind a site-wide, resource-unbound preview token (`EditorPreview::has_valid_token()`) that is NOT bound to the specific page the administrator intended to share, combined with the absence of any `list_users` or `can_user_read_post()` capability check inside `HelperFunctions:…

items.title: CVE-2026-130666
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to evade resource limits because a policy check is missing when reading XMP profiles. Attackers can supply an image with a crafted XMP profile to trigger excessive memory usage and cause denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130663
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MAGICK, XBM, XPM and UIL encoders that allows local attackers to inject content via crafted filenames. Attackers with access to the output directory and control over the filename can inject additional headers or code into the generated image source output.

items.title: CVE-2026-130661
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the ASE decoder caused by a missing security policy check. Attackers can supply crafted ASE files that evade configured resource policies to cause excessive memory usage and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-119220
items.summary: The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your Own Amazon, eBay, Etsy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3. The vulnerability exists because the `matches_mcp_endpoint()` function applies an unanchored regular expression (`#/(?:woocommerce|dokan)/mcp(?:/|$)#`) against the entire `REQUEST_URI` including the query string, meaning any request that contains the literal substring `/dokan/mcp/` or `/woocommerce/mcp/` anywhere in its URI — including inside a query parameter value — is incorrectly treated…

items.title: CVE-2026-113699
items.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Aidata Bilişim Kurumsal Tic. Ve San. A.Ş. Aidata WR854GVR allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects Aidata WR854GVR: before V4.0.18_261111.

items.title: CVE-2026-107519
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an integer underflow vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to denial of service of a cryptographic service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132126
items.summary: Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to enumerate all workspaces through an unfiltered ProjectSerializer.workspace field. Low-privilege users can request the browsable /api/projects/ page to render the project creation form, revealing every workspace UUID and name they cannot access.

items.title: CVE-2026-132122
items.summary: agentic-radar 0.7.0 before 0.14.2 contains an untrusted configuration loading vulnerability that allows malicious repositories to inject environment variables by having load_dotenv() in agentic_radar/cli.py load the scanned repository's .env file. Attackers can set OPENAI_BASE_URL to an attacker-controlled host so that scan openai-agents or --harden-prompts send requests carrying the user's OpenAI API key to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-132121
items.summary: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking vulnerability in stdio-to-WebSocket mode that allows malicious web pages to connect by bypassing missing Origin header validation. Attackers can open the /message WebSocket from a victim's browser, even against localhost-bound gateways, to initialize an MCP session and invoke wrapped stdio MCP server tools with victim privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-109864
items.summary: CAST Imaging has an access control flaw in the "/api/jobs//logs/download" endpoint. An authenticated low-privilege user can download log archives for any job whose UUID they know, even if they are not authorized to access it. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-109863
items.summary: CAST Imaging allows authenticated, low-privileged users to access parts of the administrator panel. When a user navigates to any URL path the application doesn't recognize, a wildcard route automatically redirects them to the administrative view at "/admin/applications". This allows an attacker to perform certain administrator-restricted actions, including triggering app-to-app link generation, configuring regexes, and changing searchable object properties, resulting in unauthorized modification of application configuration. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may al…

items.title: CVE-2026-109862
items.summary: CAST Imaging does not properly check whether a user is authorized to modify another user's notification settings in the "/api/admin/user/update-subscriber" endpoint. An authenticated, low-privileged attacker can enable or disable email notifications on another user's behalf, which can suppress important communications such as security alerts and disrupt business processes. The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

items.title: CVE-2026-107518
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability to make the appliance connect to attacker-chosen internal systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-130748
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to redirect reset links by forging the CloudFront-Forwarded-Proto header. Attackers can send a forgot-password request with a crafted scheme value so the emailed reset link points to their host, capturing the token to take over accounts including super admins.

items.title: CVE-2026-130745
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to read protected pages because admin and site scopes share a page cache key. Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

items.title: CVE-2026-130743
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an insecure blueprint trust vulnerability that allows publisher accounts to read secrets and execute PHP by planting or selecting attacker-controlled blueprint files. Attackers can abuse the import@ directive, uploaded YAML media named as the page template, or form.flash_folder to leak password hashes and keys or invoke static PHP methods for code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130741
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig sandbox bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to read any server file by abusing allowlisted array_key_value() and page accessor setters such as filePath(). Attackers can repoint page objects or overwrite the assets collections to render private keys and the API signing secret, then forge a super-admin API token.

items.title: CVE-2026-130740
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publishers and read-only user managers to read password hashes, 2FA secrets and reset tokens through unfiltered account serialization. Attackers can embed a Flex form for the user-accounts directory in a page or query the Flex API with admin.users.read to obtain super admin credentials and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130735
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig injection vulnerability that allows media-only accounts and anonymous uploaders to execute Twig by placing delimiters in image titles, alt text, class, id, or file names. Attackers can combine injected Twig with the autoescape tag to serve script to every page visitor, including super admins, or expose unpublished page content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130734
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with media upload rights to bypass the upload sanitizer. Attackers can upload SVG files with inner extensions like .svg.defaults, payloads that crash the fail-open sanitizer, or unblocked .xml/.xhtm files to run script when administrators open the raw file URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130733
items.summary: Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked*** or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to access the protected subtree.

items.title: CVE-2026-130731
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.05.3 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows invited users to complete other invitees' signups because batch invitations share one token across all recipients. Attackers holding a valid batch invite can submit another invitee's email with the shared non-expiring token to set its password and take over that account, including higher-role ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-130727
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in public shared-view endpoints that fetch records by primary key without applying the view's row filter. Anonymous share link holders can enumerate sequential primary keys on link, has-many, and attachment download endpoints to read excluded records' linked data and download their attachments.

items.title: CVE-2026-130725
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain signed download URLs for other bases' attachments by storing foreign attachment paths in their own rows via prepareNocoData. Attackers with write access to an attachment column can have _convertAttachmentType or the attachment download endpoint sign the foreign path, reading cross-base files despite secure attachment mode.

items.title: CVE-2026-130724
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to make backend HTTP requests by supplying arbitrary URLs to the integration remote fetch operation. Attackers can control the method, headers, and body to reach internal APIs, loopback services, and cloud metadata endpoints, reading responses and echoed decrypted integration secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-130718
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous share link holders to access records excluded by a shared view's row filter, because the read-by-primary-key path ignores the view's filters. Attackers can request the public attachment-download or nested-link listing routes with a record id to mint signed download URLs for hidden files and read linked-record data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130716
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Editor users to execute script by injecting markup into fields rendered through URL() formulas. The canvas grid renderer assigns unsanitized formula output to innerHTML, letting attackers steal session tokens from localStorage and take over accounts of users viewing the table.

items.title: CVE-2026-130715
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute database functions by supplying zero-argument function calls as column default values. Attackers can plant functions like version() or inet_server_addr() in PostgreSQL or MySQL column definitions and read results through record APIs, disclosing server addresses, role names, and engine details.

items.title: CVE-2026-130711
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in extract-ids.middleware.ts that allows authenticated users to resolve roles against another base by supplying an MCP token id in the query string. Attackers with Viewer access on one base can mint an MCP token and pass its id to read another base's metadata, including table lists and member email addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-130709
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute JavaScript by abusing Handlebars webhook helpers. Attackers can supply property paths like constructor.constructor to pluck, sortBy, filter, or withSort helpers to reach the Function constructor and run operating-system commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-130708
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows workspace Creator users to read plaintext notification webhook URLs by querying the webhook plugin listing endpoint. Attackers can replay exposed Slack, Teams, Discord and Mattermost webhook URLs directly against messaging providers to post arbitrary messages into organization chat channels.

items.title: CVE-2026-130702
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows users with the base creator role to hijack other accounts by resending base invitations. Attackers can trigger baseUserInviteResend to mint a new invite_token, read it from the base member list, and reset the victim's password through signup, taking over owner or super admin accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-130701
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because select-field option titles are embedded into MySQL or MariaDB enum/set column definitions with only single-quote doubling, leaving backslashes unescaped. A base creator or owner can end an option title with a backslash to escape the literal and append ALTER TABLE clauses, adding, dropping or renaming columns and altering indexes in the connected database.

items.title: CVE-2026-130697
items.summary: NocoDB from 0.301.4 before 2026.10.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace viewers to read pending invitation tokens through the workspace member list. Attackers can redeem an exposed higher-privileged invitation token at signup to claim the invited account and escalate to roles such as workspace owner.

items.title: CVE-2026-130696
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability in the connection-test endpoint that allows authorized integration users to redirect stored credentials by overriding connection host, port, and user fields. Attackers can point the test at a server they control to capture offline-crackable PostgreSQL md5 or MySQL handshakes and recover the stored database password.

items.title: CVE-2026-130693
items.summary: NocoDB from 0.253.0 before 2026.09.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in baseUserDelete that allows base Creators to remove higher-privileged Owners due to a broken role power comparison. Attackers holding the Creator role can remove other Owners of a base, since getProjectRolePower returns -1 for the target and never refuses the request.

items.title: CVE-2026-130692
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator-role users to execute server-side JavaScript by supplying array-form property paths to Handlebars helpers in webhook templates. Attackers can bypass the string-only prototype guard to reach the function constructor, running operating-system commands with server privileges or exfiltrating process-internal values via outbound requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-118493
items.summary: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. That user could read the generated root password and log in as root. This issue affects Apache Iggy: 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, w…

items.title: CVE-2026-111508
items.summary: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-132079
items.summary: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for. This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their lon…

items.title: CVE-2026-128719
items.summary: An issue in PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System (ELMS) Version 2.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the password recovery functionality

items.title: CVE-2026-120718
items.summary: Description: BIG-IP iControl REST tokens may not expire as expected in all scenarios. Impact: An attacker who has obtained a token may be able to extend its expiry lifetime unless the token owner deletes it. There is no data plane exposure; this is a control plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-71861
items.summary: The Chainguard SDK is a public Go SDK for integrating with the Chainguard platform. Prior to 0.1.107, auth/aws.VerifyToken trusts the Chainguard-Audience and Chainguard-Identity headers without requiring those headers to be covered by AWS SigV4 SignedHeaders. An attacker with a fresh STS GetCallerIdentity request signed by a victim can rewrite the unsigned binding headers and replay the proof to another relying party, causing the relying party to authenticate the victim’s AWS identity for an attacker-chosen audience and identity. Code that only uses auth/aws.GenerateToken is unaffected because…

items.title: CVE-2026-132224
items.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17 mishandles the account signup flow, leading to presence of attacker-controlled code in the projectJS (aka Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets.

items.title: CVE-2026-130688
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with record edit rights to inject forms, images, and styled overlays into rich text cells, which are sanitized only with DOMPurify's default policy. Attackers can place a page-sized spoofed sign-in form or remote image in a cell to harvest passwords and disclose viewer IP addresses in expanded records, gallery and kanban cards, and shared views.

items.title: CVE-2026-130687
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a stored CSS injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Commenter or Editor users to inject inline styles by placing single quotes in mention text. Attackers can break out of the single-quoted data-id attribute in comments or rich text cells to overlay or rearrange the interface for other viewers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130686
items.summary: vLLM from 0.6.0 before 0.33.0 lacks a request-wide media budget, allowing remote inference clients to exhaust frontend resources by submitting many remote image URLs in one request. Attackers can send a compact request to /v1/messages or /v1/responses that forces downloading and decoding of every image before prompt-length admission, exhausting memory, CPU, and connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-130680
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.3.0 before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTML via unescaped checkbox column names in Gallery and Kanban AttributeView renderers. Attackers can share a crafted .sy.zip document whose rendering in the Electron desktop client with nodeIntegration enabled executes Node.js and host OS commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-130679
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in genAVValueHTML() that allows attackers who can store Attribute View asset values to inject script through an unescaped image src attribute. Attackers can store an image URL containing a double quote and onerror handler that executes OS commands via Node.js in the desktop app when victims open the bound note or row attribute panel.

items.title: CVE-2026-130678
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to execute script by storing malicious Attribute View column names rendered unescaped in col.ts. Attackers can inject HTML via addAttributeViewKey, .sy.zip import, or sync, and when a victim adds or duplicates the column, insertAdjacentHTML runs JavaScript with Node.js privileges for desktop code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130677
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an improper session management vulnerability that fails to invalidate existing sessions when 2FA is enabled and allows disabling 2FA without re-authentication. Attackers holding a hijacked or stale session can retain full account access and silently remove 2FA without the password, authenticator code, or recovery code.

items.title: CVE-2026-130676
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege control panel users to inject JavaScript by poisoning cached license data. Attackers can store a malicious licensed domain via the app/process-api-response-headers endpoint, which executes unescaped in administrators' dashboard license-mismatch warnings.

items.title: CVE-2026-130673
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.5 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject raw SQL by passing nested array parameters into Element::findOne() criteria. Attackers can set the query's where property through endpoints like users/delete-address and users/save-address to perform blind boolean or time-based injection and read database contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130672
items.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ChartsController::actionGetNewUsersData() that lacks a viewUsers permission check. Authenticated control panel users can POST to the charts/get-new-users-data action to read aggregate user-registration time series and totals for the site or any user group.

items.title: CVE-2026-130671
items.summary: Parse Server before 8.6.119 and 9.x before 9.10.8-alpha.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows LiveQuery clients without the master key to subscribe to installation and internal classes. Attackers can receive installation IDs and device tokens of other devices when these classes are in liveQuery.classNames, then modify those installations to redirect push notifications.

items.title: CVE-2026-130670
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory when BGRO image data is imported. Attackers can supply crafted BGRO data for processing to crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130669
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a null pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the process by using the -subimage option on a single-image list. Attackers can supply input producing an image list with only one image while -subimage is applied, causing a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130668
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a double free vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger an invalid memory free by using the DPC compare metric. Attackers can supply images for comparison with the DPC metric to corrupt memory and crash the application, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130667
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in the TIFF decoder that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying a crafted TIFF image. Attackers can provide a malicious TIFF file that, when encoded in a specific output format, triggers a heap buffer over-write causing memory corruption.

items.title: CVE-2026-130665
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a use after free vulnerability in the EXR decoder that is triggered when a specific memory allocation fails. Attackers can supply crafted EXR images processed under memory pressure to trigger the use after free, causing crashes or memory corruption.

items.title: CVE-2026-130662
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a use after free vulnerability in the MSL decoder that can be triggered when processing crafted MSL image files. Attackers can supply a specially crafted MSL image to cause memory corruption, potentially crashing the application or leading to further compromise.

items.title: CVE-2026-130660
items.summary: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in the MVG decoder that allows attackers to read out-of-bounds memory by supplying a crafted file. Attackers can provide a malicious MVG file for processing to trigger the over-read, causing application crashes or exposure of heap memory contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-130659

items.title: CVE-2026-132049
items.summary: A flaw was found in lldpd. The service fails to verify that Link Layer Discovery Protocol - Media Endpoint Discovery (LLDP-MED) location records received from network neighbors match their declared lengths. An adjacent attacker on the local network can exploit this flaw by sending crafted packets, causing client applications using the liblldpctl library to read past buffer boundaries when parsing location data. This issue can lead to an information disclosure of adjacent process memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-126040
items.summary: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 only enforces two-factor authentication on the interactive login flow and not on other authentication paths, allowing an attacker who already has a user's valid password to authenticate as that user without completing the second factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-123662
items.summary: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 does not atomically consume the source subscription when processing a membership plan change, allowing a customer to submit concurrent plan-change checkouts against a single paid subscription and obtain several active memberships for the price of one.

items.title: CVE-2026-129705
items.summary: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, a broker with a listener that is configured to use the PROXY protocol v2 is vulnerable to an untrusted proxy providing details that cause the broker to accept fake SSL information. This can be mitigated by following the documented requirements for PROXY listeners: It is very important that only trusted proxies are allowed to connect to any listener using the PROXY protocol, and that clients are not allowed to connect to the listener at all.

items.title: CVE-2026-126708
items.summary: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.0.0 to 2.0.22 and 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the return value of password hash functions for sha512-pbkdf2 and legacy sha512 were not checked. Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

items.title: CVE-2026-130491

This results in up to 65535 bytes of uninitialised heap memory being transmitted as the Will. This can be mitigated by only passing payloads with a maximum length of 65535 bytes.

items.title: CVE-2026-131855
items.summary: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

items.title: CVE-2026-131854
items.summary: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

items.title: CVE-2026-131851
items.summary: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

items.title: CVE-2026-131850
items.summary: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

items.title: CVE-2026-131848
items.summary: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-131847
items.summary: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

items.title: CVE-2026-131843
items.summary: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-131842
items.summary: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.
